messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "1 spray in each nostril once daily for children 4 to 11 years"
set: ["1 spray in each nostril once daily for children 4 to 11 years", "1 spray in each nostril once daily for children 2 to 11 years", "use 2 sprays in each nostril once daily", "use 2 sprays in each nostril once daily during Week 1", "4 mg oral dose for patients aged 4 to 11 years", "oral administration recommended for patients aged 4 to 11 years", "do not use fluticasone propionate nasal spray for children under 4 years", "4 mg once daily", "use 1 or 2 sprays in each nostril once daily, as needed to treat your symptoms", "4 mg orally once daily", "1 to 4 days", "4 mg oral dose administered 3 times a day for patients aged 4 to 11 years", "children 4 years old and older", "children younger than 4 years old", "immediate-release (IR), ages 6 to 11 years", "OCD in children 6 to 17 years"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
